desc: Back at it again with the VR Series with RIA USA. Meet the VRPF14, a Pump Action Firearm with 14.1" Barrel with overall length slightly over 26" OAL. Great for home defense or a day at the range. Comes with F-Grip, sling adapter, and forend strap. Like all VR series, magazines are interchangeable. Chambered for 2 3/4" or 3" Magnum loads. Bring more to the VR Series.
